summary: The Sharri Briley and Eric Edmundson Veterans Benefits Expansion Act of 2026 modifies several U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs programs. It provides a supplemental monthly allowance for certain disabled veterans, temporarily increases dependency and indemnity compensation for survivors, expands home loan eligibility and updates loan fees for members of the reserve components and National Guard, and extends specific limits on pension amounts for hospitalized or institutionalized veterans.

affected_groups.effect: Receive an additional supplemental monthly allowance of $833.33 if they qualify for a monthly aid and attendance allowance due to service-connected disabilities or traumatic brain injury.
Receive temporary percentage increases (1% and then 0.5%) added to cost-of-living adjustments for dependency and indemnity compensation.
affected_groups.group: Survivors of veterans and service members

affected_groups.effect: Gain expanded access to VA home loan guarantees, with updated definitions for active duty and specific new rules and fees for individuals with at least 14 days of service.
affected_groups.group: Reserve components and National Guard members

affected_groups.effect: Subject to an extension of the existing limitation on certain pension amounts through September 30, 2036.

key_provisions: Establishes a supplemental monthly allowance of $833.33 starting December 1, 2026, for veterans eligible for a monthly aid and attendance allowance due to service-connected disabilities or traumatic brain injury.
Increases dependency and indemnity compensation (DIC) rates by an additional 1% during the next cost-of-living adjustment and an additional 0.5% during the following adjustment.

Expands Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) home loan eligibility for certain members of the reserve components and National Guard by broadening the definition of active duty to include annual training duty and service performed on or after September 11, 2001.
Grants VA home loan eligibility to certain individuals with at least 14 days of active duty service who complete entry-level and skill training, subject to an additional 1.00 loan fee.
Extends certain VA home loan fee rates through September 30, 2036, while increasing fees for certain refinancing loans and loan assumptions.
Extends the limitation on pension amounts for certain hospitalized or institutionalized veterans through September 30, 2036.

It provides a supplemental monthly allowance for certain disabled veterans, temporarily increases dependency and indemnity compensation for survivors, expands home loan eligibility and updates loan fees for members of the reserve components and National Guard, and extends specific limits on pension amounts for hospitalized or institutionalized veterans.
summary_detail.significance: This legislation alters financial benefits and loan programs administered by the Department of Veterans Affairs by adjusting compensation amounts, altering loan fees, and expanding housing loan access to more members of the National Guard and reserves.
